messages.subject: Project Harbor - draft heads of terms
messages.plaintextBody:
Daniel,

Draft heads of terms attached reflecting our call: EV £41.5m, cash-free/debt-free, 10% retention for 18 months, earn-out up to £4m on FY27 EBITDA, exclusivity to 31 December. Liability cap left open with our opening position at 100%. Subject to contract throughout except the binding exclusivity/costs/governing law paragraphs.

James

--
Whitfield Carter LLP | 22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
Confidential and may be legally privileged.
